copy.tagline: 自动执行 Affinity 中的重复性客户管理任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常在 Affinity 中手动更新记录或跟进客户
copy.tagline_en: Automate repetitive customer management tasks in Affinity
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often manually update records or follow up leads in Affinity

howto.what: 装上后，Claude能通过Rube MCP自动执行Affinity系统中的任务，比如管理联系人、交易等操作。它会先搜索可用工具，检查连接状态，再执行工具。
howto.when: 当用户要求处理Affinity相关任务（如管理联系人、交易等）时触发。Claude会先搜索工具，检查连接，再执行。

say.text: 帮我从Affinity中导出所有联系人。
say.note: Claude会先搜索工具，然后执行导出。

say.text: 更新Affinity中最近的交易信息。
say.note: Claude会查找更新交易的工具并执行。

howto.what_en: Claude can automate tasks in Affinity via Rube MCP, such as managing contacts and deals. It first discovers tools, verifies connection, then executes tools.
howto.when_en: When you ask to perform Affinity tasks (e.g., manage contacts, deals). Claude will search for tools, check connection, then execute.

say_en.note: Claude will search tools and export.

say_en.text: Update recent deal info in Affinity.
say_en.note: Claude will find update tool and execute.
